remarks:
Motivated Sellers!!!!  Welcome home to this stately brick Colonial, ideally situated in one of the area’s most desirable neighborhoods. This spacious residence offers four generously sized bedrooms, two full bathrooms, and on half bathroom, providing plenty of room for comfortable living and entertaining. The first-floor primary suite is a true retreat, featuring a cozy gas fireplace that creates the perfect place to unwind. Primary bathroom features Jacuzzi tub with an in-line heater. The home also features a large living room with a wood-burning fireplace, a formal dining room, and a welcoming foyer highlighted by elegant pink marble flooring. Upstairs, you will find three additional bedrooms and a full bathroom, offering a comfortable and private space for family or guests. A versatile game room complete with a pool table adds to the home’s entertainment appeal. Step outside to a large backyard patio, ideal for hosting gatherings, enjoying summer evenings, or simply relaxing in your private outdoor space. Additional highlights include an attached two-car garage and a brand-new concrete driveway.

Dishwasher new August 2026, furnace November 2025, AC new August 2026, hot water tank 2026, new garbage disposal, new washer and dryer, refrigerator 2025.
